flows.name: World after login with the build loaded
steps: Select SkillUp's page through ForeverCore.ProfessionTabs.Select("skillup"): the Lua run reports ok
The character is a ghost, so the client keeps the Professions window closed; the world shows with no error from SkillUp

flows.name: SkillUp settings
steps: The settings index opens with its six pages

notes: Recorded in the client from an installed source-tree build of this commit. This change has no new visible surface: it removes a tooltip refresh and makes a route row return to the game's recipe page. The bag item and recipe selection behaviour is covered by tests/sim/bag_item_use_scenario.lua and tests/sim/show_recipe_scenario.lua.
